Enter the destination or hotel name, check-in/check-out dates, number of rooms and number of guests.
Search the available properties and compare the location, amenities, room type, price and cancellation conditions.
Choose the room, enter the required guest details and complete payment using an available card or bank-transfer option.
Save the booking confirmation voucher sent by email because Wakanow says it serves as proof of the reservation at check-in.
notes: Wakanow says an unpaid hotel reservation may remain valid for up to 24 hours when instant purchase is not required.
Room refundability and cancellation conditions vary by hotel and room type.
Hotel prices and availability can change when an unpaid reservation expires.

title: How to cancel a Wakanow hotel reservation
summary: Wakanow's hotel-cancellation route depends on the hotel's room policy: some bookings allow free cancellation, some charge a fee and others are non-refundable.
feeLabel: Cancellation charge depends on the hotel and room policy
feeNote: Wakanow states that cancellation can be free, charged or completely non-refundable depending on the booked hotel/room and cancellation timing. Check the booking's policy before requesting cancellation.
timeline: Wakanow's support material says confirmed hotel cancellations should be requested through its support channels at least 48 hours before check-in, subject to the property's cancellation policy.
requirements: The Wakanow hotel booking or confirmation details
The cancellation policy attached to the booked hotel and room type
A cancellation request submitted through Wakanow's official support channel
Bank details when a refundable booking qualifies for a refund and Wakanow requests them
steps: Open the Wakanow booking confirmation and read the cancellation terms for the selected room before requesting a change.
Contact Wakanow through the official in-app/help-centre, email or support route and provide the hotel reservation details.
Submit the cancellation request at least 48 hours before check-in when the booking policy allows cancellation.
Review any cancellation charge or non-refundable condition that Wakanow confirms for the booked room.
For an eligible refund, provide the requested bank details and keep the cancellation/refund confirmation until the money is received.
notes: A refundable room is not automatically free to cancel at every point; grace periods and later fees can apply.
Some room rates are non-cancellable and non-refundable from the time of booking.
Wakanow states that eligible hotel refunds are processed after applicable charges are deducted.

title: How to subscribe to DStv Stream in Nigeria without a decoder
summary: DStv Nigeria's streaming-only subscription route lets customers choose an eligible package, create login details, set up payment and stream on compatible devices without a decoder or satellite dish.
feeNote: DStv publishes current Nigeria streaming-only package prices on its package pages. Prices can change, so use the live amount shown for Premium, Compact Plus, Compact, Confam or Yanga before payment.
timeline: Streaming can begin after the package is selected, login details are created and the payment setup is completed successfully.
requirements: A DStv account/login or the ability to create DStv login details
A selected streaming-only package available in Nigeria
A compatible smartphone, tablet, smart TV or web browser with an internet connection
A supported payment method for the selected package
steps: Open DStv Nigeria's official Streaming page and compare the streaming-only packages currently offered.
Select the package that matches the customer's viewing needs and review the current monthly price.
Create or sign in with the DStv login details requested during the purchase flow.
Set up the payment method and complete the subscription purchase.
Download the DStv app or use a compatible web browser, sign in and start streaming the channels and on-demand content included in the package.
notes: DStv states that streaming-only subscriptions do not require a decoder or satellite dish.
The current streaming page lists Premium, Compact Plus, Compact, Confam and Yanga as streaming-only options.
Device registration and simultaneous-stream limits depend on the active DStv rules and package.

title: How former Showmax users can continue streaming in Nigeria
summary: Showmax Nigeria was discontinued on 30 April 2026. The current official route for continuing with Showmax Originals is to use DStv Stream and an eligible DStv streaming package.
feeNote: The standalone Showmax service has ended. Continuing access requires an eligible DStv Stream subscription; current package prices are shown on DStv Nigeria's streaming pages.
timeline: Showmax stopped operating at 23:59 on 30 April 2026. Former subscribers can move to DStv Stream now, subject to the current package and account options.
requirements: Awareness that the standalone Showmax app and subscription service has been discontinued in Nigeria
A DStv Stream account or the ability to create DStv login details
An eligible DStv Stream package that includes the Showmax Originals section
A compatible streaming device and internet connection
steps: Open Showmax Nigeria's official migration page and confirm that the standalone Showmax service has ended.
If the former Showmax account received a migration email or offer, review those account-specific instructions before purchasing another package.
Open DStv Nigeria's streaming page and choose an eligible streaming package such as Compact, Compact Plus or Premium when Showmax Originals access is required.
Create or sign in to the DStv account, set up payment and activate the selected streaming package.
Open DStv Stream and use the dedicated Showmax section for the titles that have moved to the platform.
notes: Showmax states that its standalone app was discontinued on 30 April 2026.
Showmax profiles and watch history do not move to DStv Stream.
Not every title that previously appeared on Showmax is guaranteed to move because content licensing differs.

title: How to create a Chowdeck account and start ordering
summary: Chowdeck's customer onboarding route for creating an account with phone/email verification, then using a delivery address to order food, groceries, pharmacy items and other supported services.
feeNote: Chowdeck does not state a fee for creating a customer account. Order prices, delivery charges, service fees and promotions are shown in the app before checkout.
timeline: Account signup is completed after the OTP verification succeeds; order delivery time then depends on merchant preparation, distance, traffic and rider availability.
requirements: The Chowdeck mobile app from the official app-store link
The customer's first name, last name, phone number and email address
Access to the SMS and email inboxes used to receive the account-verification OTP
A delivery address in a city or area currently served by Chowdeck
steps: Download the official Chowdeck app and tap Create one to begin customer registration.
Enter the customer's first name, last name, phone number, email address and referral code if one is being used.
Enter the OTP sent by SMS and email to verify the customer profile.
Set or enter the delivery address and browse the restaurants, groceries, pharmacies, markets or other services available for that location.
Select the items, review the order charges and delivery details, complete checkout and follow the live order updates in the app.
notes: Chowdeck's current help centre lists Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt, Ilorin, Abeokuta, Enugu, Kaduna, Owerri, Benin, Oyo, Ife and Kano among its Nigerian service cities.
The platform also offers services beyond prepared food, including groceries, pharmacy orders and local-market items.
Promotional first-order discounts can change and are intentionally not treated as permanent account terms.

title: How to register a restaurant or store on Chowdeck
summary: Chowdeck's Vendor Hub onboarding route for restaurants and eligible stores, covering business/contact details, KYC, settlement bank information, menu setup, operating settings and automatic activation.
feeNote: Chowdeck's vendor onboarding guide does not state one universal signup fee. Service fees, commissions and optional advertising terms are managed separately in the Vendor Hub.
timeline: Chowdeck says the store activates automatically after every onboarding-checklist phase is marked Done and the phone number is verified; there is no separate manual approval wait after completion.
requirements: A physical restaurant, food business, supermarket, store or pharmacy in a location Chowdeck currently supports
The business legal name, store address and primary contact information
KYC/compliance evidence including the business registration certificate when required for full access
A settlement bank account name and number that can be verified
A complete menu/catalogue with item names, descriptions, prices, variants/add-ons and clear product images
steps: Confirm that Chowdeck currently serves the business's exact location, then download the official Chowdeck Vendor app.
Create the vendor profile and complete the Business & Contact Details section with the legal name, store address and contacts.
Upload the KYC/compliance information and complete the bank and settlement-account verification.
Build the menu/catalogue and complete the opening hours, preparation time, pickup instructions, fulfilment preferences and quality-review checklist.
Verify the business phone number and confirm that every onboarding phase shows Done; Chowdeck says the store then activates automatically and starts appearing in the customer app.
notes: Chowdeck currently allows some unregistered businesses to start with restricted access, but its August 2026 policy imposes a ₦100,000 lifetime trading cap until CAC registration is completed.
Exact city coverage depends on the restaurant's location, not only the city name.
Menu quality, item categorisation and images are part of the activation checklist rather than optional post-launch work.

title: How to register as a Chowdeck rider
summary: Chowdeck's rider onboarding route through the Rider app, including identity/NIN verification, vehicle details, onboarding orientation, bank information and activation for delivery requests.
feeNote: Chowdeck's current rider-onboarding article does not state a fee for registering in the Rider app.
timeline: After app registration and identity verification, Chowdeck says the onboarding team contacts the applicant for orientation before final activation; no fixed number of days is published.
requirements: A rider who is at least 18 years old
A vehicle suitable for delivery, such as a bike or bicycle, plus the vehicle information requested in the app
A valid means of identification and NIN for identity verification
A phone number, email address and city of operation
A completed rider profile with photo and bank-account information before activation
steps: Download the official Chowdeck Rider app and register with the rider's name, phone number, email, city and vehicle type.
Upload the valid identification and complete the NIN identity-verification process in the app.
Wait for Chowdeck's onboarding team to contact the rider with an invitation to the required orientation session.
Attend orientation to learn the Rider app, delivery process, policies, performance expectations and payout process.
Complete the profile photo, vehicle and bank-account information and set availability after Chowdeck activates the rider account.
notes: Chowdeck says signing up in the Rider app is enough to start the onboarding process; a separate emailed application form is not needed.
The account shows identity verification as Verified, Pending or Failed.
Activation follows successful verification and onboarding rather than immediate signup alone.

title: How to advertise a business on Chowdeck
summary: Chowdeck Ads lets vendors and external brands create funded advertising campaigns for customers inside the Chowdeck ecosystem, with vendor self-service and managed brand campaigns.
feeNote: Chowdeck's current Ads page says vendors can start with a ₦100,000 wallet top-up and receive a first-top-up bonus, while placements use CPM or flat-rate pricing. Promotional credits can change.
timeline: Chowdeck says advertising campaigns are reviewed within 24 hours before going live.
requirements: An eligible Chowdeck vendor account for self-serve advertising, or a brand using the managed campaign route
An advertising objective, creative assets and the intended audience/location targeting
A funded advertising wallet or approved managed-campaign budget
Compliance with Chowdeck's campaign-review and creative requirements
steps: Open Chowdeck Ads and choose the vendor self-service or external-brand advertising route.
Create the advertising account or enter the vendor dashboard and fund the advertising wallet with the intended budget.
Build the campaign by choosing the placement, uploading the creative and selecting the target location, audience and zone.
Set the budget and review the CPM or flat-rate pricing shown for the selected placement.
Submit the campaign for review and monitor its performance after Chowdeck approves and launches it.
notes: Chowdeck says every campaign is reviewed before launch and targets a 24-hour approval window.
Vendor and external-brand campaign options are not identical; external brands can use managed pop-ups, push notifications and sponsored placements.
Promotional ad credits are temporary marketing terms and should be rechecked before funding.

title: How to register as an ICAN professional student
summary: ICAN's professional-student registration route for qualified applicants using the professional portal, payment reference, online form, certified credentials and endorsement by a Chartered Accountant.
feeLabel: ICAN official pages currently show differing registration amounts
feeNote: ICAN's current Professional Student page says ₦11,400 including bank charges, while another current ICAN registration-procedure page states ₦10,000 plus transaction charges. Confirm the amount generated by the professional portal before paying.
timeline: ICAN does not publish one fixed approval time for every professional-student application; the applicant must complete the online registration and submit the required endorsed/certified documentation.
requirements: An approved entry qualification, generally a university degree/HND or another professional/technical qualification accepted by ICAN
A phone number and email address for the professional-student registration portal
Certified copies of the applicant's educational credentials and supporting NYSC discharge/call-up or academic transcript evidence where applicable
A completed registration form endorsed by a Chartered Accountant
The transaction reference/official payment evidence generated for the professional-student registration
steps: Open ICAN's official professional-student page and confirm that the applicant's academic or professional qualification appears in the accepted entry routes.
Open the ICAN professional portal, choose New Student Registration and enter the phone number and email address.
Generate the transaction reference and pay the amount currently generated by the official portal rather than relying on an older fee figure.
Complete the online registration form, submit it, print the completed form and sign it.
Attach the certified credentials, payment evidence and required NYSC/transcript documents, obtain the Chartered Accountant endorsement and submit the application through an ICAN office as instructed.
notes: ICAN's own current pages contain different registration-fee wording, so this guide intentionally marks the fee as a conflict.
The registration page lists degrees/HND and several recognised professional/technical qualifications as entry routes.
Professional-student registration is separate from registering for a specific examination diet.

title: How to register for an ICAN professional examination
summary: ICAN's professional-exam registration route for existing students: check financial/exam status, clear subscriptions, select eligible papers and centre, pay online and complete the exam registration before the diet deadline.
feeLabel: Varies by level and number of papers
feeNote: ICAN's current fee table varies by Foundation, Skills or Professional level and paper count. Confirm the exact amount from the student's financial/exam status before making the non-refundable payment.
timeline: The November 2026 Professional Examination is scheduled for 10–12 November 2026. Registration must be completed before ICAN's published diet deadline; payment alone does not complete exam registration.
requirements: An active ICAN professional-student registration number
Cleared annual-subscription arrears before exam registration
An examination/financial status showing the papers the student is eligible to enter
Selection of an approved examination centre and the intended papers
Online payment of the applicable examination fee through the official ICAN portal
steps: Open the ICAN professional portal and check the student's Examination and Financial Status before paying.
Clear any outstanding annual subscription separately because ICAN says students with arrears cannot register for examinations.
Open the professional exam-registration page, choose the eligible papers and preferred examination centre.
Pay the examination amount shown for the selected papers through the official online portal and keep the transaction receipt.
Complete and submit the online examination registration before the published diet deadline, then later download the docket/attendance information from ICAN.
notes: ICAN warns that examination fees are non-refundable and exams cannot be deferred to another diet after payment.
ICAN advises students not to use third parties or proxies for examination registration.
For Nigeria-based candidates, the 2026 exam guidance directs examination-registration payments through the online ICAN portal.
